description: Unit: createEmailService() with provider 'smtp' returns a working sender (no 'not implemented' throw) and the dead ProductionEmailService stubs are gone
Unit: the Temporal email layer routes a send through the shared packages/email SMTP provider (assert the shared provider is invoked)
Regression: createEmailService() with provider 'resend' and a valid key still uses Resend (cloud path unbroken)
Unit: in appliance mode, a system/Temporal send resolves the single tenant's enabled SMTP providerConfig (not env) when one is configured
Unit: with no tenant provider configured yet, the send falls back to env EMAIL_* config (pre-onboarding path)
Smoke: sendWelcomeEmail with a configured SMTP provider delivers a message to a test SMTP sink (e.g. Mailpit) and returns success
Smoke: sendWelcomeEmail with no provider configured no-ops cleanly (no crash) and logs that email is unconfigured
Unit: temporal-worker startupValidation passes with SMTP email and no RESEND_API_KEY
Unit: temporal-worker startupValidation still fails fast with EMAIL_PROVIDER=resend and no key (cloud safety preserved)
Smoke (build): temporal-worker image builds via the Argo/Dockerfile.build path with the packages/email dependency (the build itself is the check for ESM/CJS resolution)
Smoke (VM): temporal-worker pod starts healthy on the appliance image with SMTP email config
Smoke: appliance alga-core values render EMAIL_PROVIDER_TYPE=smtp into the deployment env (helm render / live pod env)
Unit: with EMAIL_PROVIDER_TYPE=smtp set, Resend is never auto-selected even if a stray RESEND_API_KEY is present
Smoke: a system email (non-tenant path) on the appliance sends via the tenant's configured SMTP provider
Unit: missing SMTP host/user/pass produces an error naming EMAIL_HOST/EMAIL_USERNAME/EMAIL_PASSWORD, never RESEND_API_KEY, on the appliance
Smoke (status): status surface shows 'Email: configured' after SMTP is set and 'unconfigured' before
Smoke: configuring SMTP in Communications > Outbound Email and saving results in tenant business email being delivered via that SMTP server on the appliance
Smoke (VM): the email-service pod can HTTP POST to the configured alga-core webhook endpoint and receive 2xx
Smoke: appliance email-service values render a non-empty IMAP_WEBHOOK_URL (not server:3000) into the pod env
Unit: with webhook.url set, resolveWebhookUrl never returns the http://server:3000 fallback
Unit: resolveWebhookUrl with no configured URL throws/logs a clear error instead of silently using server:3000
Smoke: an inbound IMAP message is fetched, posted to the webhook, authenticated via IMAP_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and produces a ticket/thread on the appliance
Smoke (negative): a webhook POST with a wrong/missing secret is rejected (401/403)
Smoke (VM, single-host): with DNS+TLS in front and NEXTAUTH_URL set to the vanity host, the client portal loads and a client can log in on the vanity domain with existing code only
Unit: the mark-active admin action inserts/updates a portal_domains row with status='active' via upsertPortalDomain and does NOT enqueue a workflow (workflow client not called)
Smoke: on the appliance, adding a custom domain in client-portal settings calls the mark-active path (no Temporal portal-domain run created)

Smoke (VM, multi-host): with the LB routing a separate vanity host to the app, an active portal_domains row, and PORTAL_DOMAIN_DNS_CHECK=false, the client portal serves on the vanity host while MSP stays on the main host
Regression (unit): in cloud/SaaS mode the custom-domain path still enqueues the provisioning workflow; in appliance mode it does not (appliance gating doesn't leak to cloud)
Smoke: managed email-domain (SPF/DKIM) settings panel is not rendered in appliance mode
Smoke (regression): the managed-domain panel IS rendered in cloud/EE mode
Unit: managedDomainActions short-circuit in appliance mode and never throw 'requires RESEND_API_KEY' to the operator
Unit: the appliance-mode predicate returns true on the appliance (license_state row / APPLIANCE_MODE) and false in cloud
Smoke: the check-in task POSTs appliance_credential to check_in_url with the expected request shape (host-service task, validate live)
Smoke: the check-in task is scheduled and fires on its interval
Smoke (contract): a check-in against the live alga-license refresh endpoint returns a refreshed JWT in the agreed shape
Unit: a refreshed JWT failing public-key verification is rejected and NOT stored (packages/licensing verify)
Unit: a validly-signed refreshed JWT passes verification and is accepted
Smoke: a successful check-in updates both the license Secret and the license_state row; resolved tier reflects the new token
Smoke: a failed check-in retries with backoff and does not crash or block the app
Smoke: repeated check-in failures surface a visible warning but the appliance keeps running on the last-valid JWT until exp
Smoke: an appliance with no check_in_url (airgap) does not attempt check-in
Smoke: License UI shows tier, exp, and last-check-in; 'refresh now' triggers an immediate check-in
Smoke: a license within the pre-expiry window shows a warning banner
Smoke (preflight): reachability check passes when both endpoints are reachable
Smoke (preflight): blocking ghcr.io or license.nineminds.com yields a specific, actionable preflight error
Unit: nm-store middleware / billing routes are inert/fail-closed in appliance mode (no nm_store_api_key configured)
Unit: isLicenseDistributionTenant() returns false on the appliance (no MASTER_BILLING_TENANT_ID match), hiding the Stripe distribution surface
Smoke (VM, no Resend reachability): fresh appliance + SMTP relay only — system email sends, tenant email sends, Temporal welcome email sends, inbound IMAP creates a ticket
Smoke (VM): the welcome/onboarding email (Temporal path) is delivered to the SMTP sink during a real tenant onboarding
Smoke: the full Phase-1 change set passes a clean libvirt VM install on the real Argo-built nightly image
Smoke: after VM sign-off, release.json/channels pin the validated image and a re-install from that pin is fullyHealthy
Smoke (VM): a connected appliance auto-renews its license across a simulated exp boundary and the pre-expiry warning clears after a successful check-in
